clue.text: What's often described as glorious island in game reserve

parts.note: the Glorious Twelfth is 12 August, the opening of the grouse-shooting season in Britain
the Isle of Man, the island in the Irish Sea

explanation.surface: Someone describes a splendid island set within a wildlife park.
explanation.walkthrough: 'game reserve' looks like a wildlife park, but here it is a substitute player in cricket.
explanation.definitionFit: In cricket the extra fielder who comes on as a substitute is a reserve for the match.

clue.text: Girl takes hold of right tool

indicators.note: one word gripping another means the second sits inside the first

parts.note: wench is an old word for a girl

explanation.surface: A young woman grabs the proper implement.
explanation.definitionFit: A spanner for turning nuts, especially an adjustable one, is a kind of hand tool.

clue.text: Guide's leotard's damaged

indicators.note: something damaged is knocked out of shape, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A girl guide's dancing costume has been torn.
explanation.walkthrough: The first 's means 'is', a link; the S of "leotard's" is part of the fodder, giving LEOTARDS to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: A star used for navigation, especially the pole star, is something that guides a traveller.

clue.text: Negative digits not available for computing

parts.note: thumbs are digits of the hand
a computer system that is not working is said to be down

explanation.surface: A complaint that fingers cannot be used to work a computer.
explanation.definitionFit: The gesture of a turned-over thumb signals rejection, so the phrase means a refusal or disapproval.

clue.text: Pick a race to scoff about

indicators.note: one piece placed about another goes round it

parts.note: to scoff is to mock
the TT is the Tourist Trophy motorcycle race on the Isle of Man

explanation.surface: Choose a contest where you can jeer at the competitors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pick' looks like a verb but is the noun, a digging tool.
explanation.definitionFit: A digging tool with a broad blade on one side is a kind of pickaxe.

clue.text: Standard choice between central characters?

indicators.note: one piece set between two others sits in the middle of them

parts.note: M and N are the 13th and 14th letters, the middle pair of the alphabet
'or' is the word that offers a choice

explanation.surface: A question about the usual way of choosing between two leading actors.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that 'central characters' means the middle letters of the alphabet, not the stars of a play.
explanation.definitionFit: A norm is the usual level or benchmark, a synonym of a standard.

clue.text: State with a rich source for zinc ore

parts.note: Cal is an abbreviation for California, a US state
a mine is a rich source of something, as in a mine of information

explanation.surface: A state that has a plentiful supply of a zinc mineral.
explanation.definitionFit: Calamine is a zinc mineral, zinc carbonate or silicate, mined as an ore.

clue.text: Irregular levy, the soldiers being enrolled forcibly

indicators.note: soldiers enrolled are taken into the body, so they go inside it
something irregular is out of order, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: men is a common word for soldiers

explanation.surface: An unlawful tax, with the troops being conscripted by force.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Irregular' gives VEHETLY, and 'being enrolled' takes the soldiers into it; the press-gang picture hides that 'forcibly' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting with great force or passion is acting with strong vigour.

clue.text: Notes peculiar behaviour of avocet

indicators.note: the word avocet behaving oddly means its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A naturalist records the strange habits of a wading bird.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Notes' looks like a verb, but it is the definition: eight notes of a scale.
explanation.definitionFit: An octave is a series of eight musical notes spanning a scale.

clue.text: Do some further revision to study? Exactly!

parts.note: to read a subject at university is to study it
just means exactly, as in just right

explanation.surface: A student asks whether revising again counts as study and is told yes.
explanation.definitionFit: To adjust again is to revise or modify something once more.

clue.text: Model needs a little time in church

indicators.note: one piece placed in another sits inside it

parts.note: a temple is a place of worship
T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: A sitter needs to spend a moment in a place of worship.
explanation.definitionFit: A template is a pattern or shape used as a guide for making copies.

clue.text: A little bit innocent, but not entirely

indicators.note: not entirely means the word is cut short, losing its final letter

parts.note: white is used for pure or innocent, as in a white lie

explanation.surface: Someone is only slightly blameless, not completely so.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiny amount, as in 'not a jot', is a small particle of something.

clue.text: 25'sliving here in quarters, and making progress

annotationWithheld.why: '25's living here in quarters, and making progress' gives W E (quarters) + STRIDING, but 25 is PRIMROSE and no sense of primrose living in the West Riding can be confirmed for the definition
annotationWithheld.clue: 25'sliving here in quarters, and making progress

clue.text: Piece of furniture put on display inside cover

indicators.note: one piece put inside another sits within it

parts.note: to secrete is to hide or cover up
to air something is to show it in public

explanation.surface: An item is exhibited within a protective case.
explanation.definitionFit: A secretaire is a writing desk with drawers, a kind of bureau.

clue.text: Three vying contentiously a great deal

indicators.note: arguing contentiously throws things into disorder, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Three rivals compete quarrelsomely for a big prize.
explanation.definitionFit: Used informally, it means something of supreme importance, as in 'it meant all to me'.

clue.text: Fights Robin's killer with bow

parts.note: to spar is to box or fight
a row is a fight or quarrel

explanation.surface: An archer kills a robin in a brawl.
explanation.walkthrough: In the nursery rhyme 'Who killed Cock Robin?', the bird answers 'I, with my bow and arrow'; 'Fights' supplies two separate fights.
explanation.definitionFit: In the rhyme the small brown bird confesses to shooting the robin with a bow and arrow.

clue.text: Near a fish, enter very quietly

indicators.note: the letters go into the middle of the other piece

parts.note: a roach is a freshwater fish
pp, pianissimo, is the musical direction for very quietly

explanation.surface: Get close to a fish by creeping up silently.
explanation.definitionFit: To approach is to come close to, so it serves as a verb for drawing near.

clue.text: Line of French perfume

parts.note: de is French for of
scent is a perfume

explanation.surface: A range of perfumes from a French house.
explanation.definitionFit: A line of descent is a family lineage, ancestry passed down the generations.

clue.text: One who performs magic trick before a panellist

indicators.note: in a down clue one piece before another is written above it

parts.note: a con is a trick or swindle
a juror sits on a jury panel

explanation.surface: A magician plays a trick on a member of a quiz panel.
explanation.definitionFit: A magician or illusionist performs sleight of hand for an audience.

clue.text: Paddy's after bargain scrap of material

indicators.note: one piece coming after another follows it in the answer

parts.note: a snip is a bargain, something cheap
a paddy is a fit of temper, as is a pet; the 's means is

explanation.surface: An Irishman goes looking for a cheap remnant of cloth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Paddy' looks like an Irishman's name, but it is a tantrum.
explanation.definitionFit: A small piece cut off something is a fragment or cutting.

clue.text: In connection with dog, girl shows antipathy

parts.note: re means about or concerning
a pug is a small breed of dog
Nancy is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl shows dislike in the matter of a dog.
explanation.definitionFit: Repugnance, strong dislike or aversion, is the same feeling.

clue.text: Refusal to accept 22 ships

indicators.note: a word taking in another holds it inside

parts.note: nay is an old word for no
the answer to 22-down abbreviates to V, as in sport fixtures

explanation.surface: A refusal to take on a fleet of ships.
explanation.definitionFit: A nation's fleet of warships makes up its sea force.

clue.text: Opposed to dubious character vicar's taken up

indicators.note: in a down clue taking something up reads it from the bottom, so the letters run backwards

parts.note: sus is slang for a suspect, someone suspicious
Rev, short for Reverend, is the title of a vicar; the 's means has

explanation.surface: A churchman takes in a shady figure and stands against him.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin word for against, used in contests and lawsuits, means set opposite.

clue.text: Visit every house to find piece of bread

definitions.meaning: to canvass by calling at each home in turn
a very thick slice cut from a loaf

explanation.surface: Someone goes from house to house looking for bread.
explanation.definitionFit: Canvassers go door to door, and a very thick slice of bread is a thick wedge.

clue.text: Toiletry packed in metal container

indicators.note: letters packed in the words are tucked inside them

explanation.surface: A bathroom product sold in a tin.
explanation.definitionFit: Talcum powder is a toilet powder for the skin.

clue.text: Go on across border — it's open in spring

indicators.note: one piece set across another spans it, going inside

parts.note: to prose is to talk on at tedious length
a rim is a border or edge

explanation.surface: Keep walking over the boundary in spring.
explanation.definitionFit: A pale yellow wild flower blooms early in spring.

clue.text: King's head incorporated in attractive pound coin

indicators.note: one piece incorporated in another goes inside it

parts.note: nice means pleasing or attractive

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter

parts.note: L, from Latin libra, is the abbreviation for a pound

explanation.surface: A monarch's portrait appears on a handsome coin.
explanation.definitionFit: The American five-cent piece is a coin.

clue.text: Sort of animal I, for one of the classics, mount

parts.note: a cat is an animal

parts.words: I, for one of the classics
parts.note: ego is the Latin word for I, Latin being one of the classical languages
to mount is to rise

explanation.surface: Some sort of creature climbs, as one of the classics.
explanation.definitionFit: To categorise is to classify things into groups.
